x: Lieut. Ron Patience, who is trying to work up some enthusiasm in the Shetlands.
Ron. Patience has now returned from the Shetlands, is also married.

Percy Wright seems to have started this with his two sons, and has been followed by Charlie Smart, Bill Webb, Ron. Patience, Bill Sutton and Ben May, to all of whom we offer our congratulations.—What a team for 1962!
Congratulations to the following fathers: Tom Pritchard (girl), Les Daniels (girl), Len Marchant (boy), George Lucas (girl), Tom Cotton (girl), Ted Stimson (boy), Ron Patience (boy).

Members such as Dan, Alec and Ron Patience, Ted Stimpson, Charlie Smart, Jim Ginty, Arthur Penny, Pat Parker, Jimmy Kemp, Bill Lucas and a host of others, not forgetting Bert Footer, the Club's greatest captain of all time.
Ron Patience was second in the N. Ireland Command three miles' championship.
The Club expresses deepest sympathy with Ron Patience and his wife in the sad loss of their young son, aged nine, who was killed while at play.
